echoParts: that he lay down his life
verseText: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
meaning: The greatest love is shown by giving up your life for someone else. Jesus showed this perfect love when he died in our place on the cross.

recall.question: What does Jesus say is the greatest way to show love for your friends?

meaning.question: How did Jesus show us this greatest kind of love?
choices: He died on the cross for our sins

application.prompt: Jesus is the greatest friend of all. He proved it by giving His life for us! You can show that same kind of selfless love in smaller ways, too. Maybe you can share something special, help someone when you'd rather play, or stand up for a friend. Remember, real love sometimes means putting someone else's needs before your own!
